# SellWant

> A two-sided marketplace for event tickets, mostly student parties, formals
> and concerts. People post tickets they are selling **and** tickets they are
> looking for. Offers are public, so the going rate is visible before anyone
> commits. SellWant never touches the money and never holds the ticket.

## How the model works

Two listing types, and the distinction matters:

- **sell** — someone has a ticket and names a price. Marked up as
  `schema.org/Offer`.
- **want** — someone needs a ticket and names what they will pay. Marked up as
  `schema.org/Demand`. This is not a product page with no stock; it is a
  standing request, and answering it means offering to sell.

Anyone may post either. There is no `.edu` requirement.

**Offers are public.** Any signed-in person can offer on a listing, and the
poster can counter. The highest offer on a sell listing, and the lowest on a
want listing, are shown as the going rate. A counter from the poster is
displayed but deliberately excluded from that figure: it is their own asking
price, not evidence of demand.

**Money never moves through SellWant.** "Buying" means agreeing a price and a
place to meet. Payment happens directly between the two people, usually Venmo
or Zelle, and the platform cannot see, verify, hold or refund it.

**The handoff is physical.** Tickets are typically static QR codes that cannot
be transferred, so the seller keeps a working copy. The two people meet and
scan in together. There is no digital delivery.

## What this means for an agent

An agent can usefully **find, compare, and negotiate**: search listings, read
the going rate, draft an offer for its person to approve.

An agent **cannot complete a trade**. Someone has to turn up at a door. Any
flow that ends in "purchased" is wrong; the honest end state is "a price is
agreed and a meeting is arranged".

There is no public write API yet. Reading is open and unauthenticated; posting
and offering require a signed-in account through the site.

## Data

- [Feed](https://sellwant.com/): every active listing, rendered server-side
- [Sitemap](https://sellwant.com/sitemap.xml): every active listing URL
- Listing pages carry JSON-LD (`Event` with `Offer` or `Demand`)

Only **active** listings are exposed anywhere. Sold and cancelled ones are
withheld on purpose: a completed trade's price is private to the two people
who made it.

## Optional

- [Sign in](https://sellwant.com/signin): required to post or offer
- Identity — names, Instagram handles, handoff counts — is visible only to
  signed-in people, and contact details only to the two parties in a deal.
  Nothing here exposes them.
